cells.text:
# Portfolio AI analytics
Private report for project members. Possible hiring interest is a keyword heuristic, not visitor identity or proof of employer intent. Questions/responses have best-effort redaction, which is not anonymization. API acceptance does not prove factual correctness or that the browser displayed the response. Logs are retained for at most three calendar months; hourly cleanup may expire oldest logs sooner to keep under 100,000 rows / 150 MiB estimated live data. Synthetic setup calls are excluded below.

cells.title: Possible hiring interest — newest questions
cells.sql: select created_at, question, response, outcome, accepted, citations_valid, source_ids, id from public.ai_api_calls where possible_hiring_interest and model is distinct from 'synthetic-only' order by created_at desc limit 50;

cells.title: Daily questions and possible hiring interest
cells.sql: select created_at::date as day, count(*) as calls, count(*) filter(where possible_hiring_interest) as possible_hiring from public.ai_api_calls where model is distinct from 'synthetic-only' group by 1 order by 1;

cells.title: Recent answer and failure outcomes
cells.sql: select outcome, count(*) as calls, round(avg(duration_ms)) as average_ms from public.ai_api_calls where created_at >= now()-interval '7 days' and model is distinct from 'synthetic-only' group by outcome order by calls desc;

cells.title: Storage and retention headroom
cells.sql: select count(*) as records, coalesce(sum(estimated_bytes),0) as estimated_live_bytes, 157286400 as estimated_byte_budget, 100000 as row_budget, min(created_at) as oldest_record, pg_total_relation_size('public.ai_api_calls') as allocated_table_bytes, pg_database_size(current_database()) as allocated_database_bytes from public.ai_api_calls;

cells.title: Latest API calls
cells.sql: select created_at, possible_hiring_interest, question, response, outcome, accepted, model, id from public.ai_api_calls where model is distinct from 'synthetic-only' order by created_at desc limit 50;
